Title: Document 7
Content: Source: Anonymous parody of the Lord's Prayer, a traditional Christian prayer, that circulated in France during the War of the Spanish Succession (`text(1701)-text(1714)`), late in Louis `text(XIV's)` reign

:ibox:Our Father at Versailles,
Your name is no longer hallowed.
Your kingdom is a shambles.
Your will is no longer done.
Give us the bread that we lack.
May our enemies forgive our blunders.
Save us from Chamillart* and La Maintenon.**
References: finance minister and war minister in the later part of Louis `text(XIV's)` reign
